t: 英格兰国王查理二世向荷兰宣战,标志着第二次盎格鲁-荷兰战争的开始.
te: English King Charles II declares war on the Netherlands, marking the start of the Second Anglo-Dutch War.
dz: 英格兰国王查理二世向荷兰宣战,标志着第二次盎格鲁-荷兰战争的开始.
de: English King Charles II declares war on the Netherlands, marking the start of the Second Anglo-Dutch War.

t: 约克公爵詹姆斯·斯图亚特(后成为英格兰国王詹姆斯二世)在洛韦斯托夫特近海击败了荷兰分舰队.
te: James Stuart, Duke of York (later to become King James II of England), defeats the Dutch fleet off the coast of Lowesto…
dz: 约克公爵詹姆斯·斯图亚特(后成为英格兰国王詹姆斯二世)在洛韦斯托夫特近海击败了荷兰分舰队.
de: James Stuart, Duke of York (later to become King James II of England), defeats the Dutch fleet off the coast of Lowestoft.

t: 托马斯·威利特被任命为纽约市首任市长.
te: Thomas Willett is appointed the first mayor of New York City.
dz: 托马斯·威利特被任命为纽约市首任市长.
de: Thomas Willett is appointed the first mayor of New York City.

t: 蒙特斯克拉夫罗斯战役(Battle of Montes Claros):葡萄牙在葡萄牙恢复战争…
te: Portugal definitively secures independence from Spain in the last battle of the Portuguese Restoration War.
dz: 蒙特斯克拉夫罗斯战役(Battle of Montes Claros):葡萄牙在葡萄牙恢复战争的最后一场战役中,最终确保了从西班牙独立.
de: Battle of Montes Claros: Portugal definitively secures independence from Spain in the last battle of the Portuguese Restoration War.

t: 葡萄牙军队击败了孔戈王国并斩首了孔戈国王安东尼奥一世,又被称作"恩维塔"(Nvita a Nk…
te: Portuguese forces defeat the Kingdom of Kongo and decapitate King António I of Kongo, also known as Nvita a Nkanga.
dz: 葡萄牙军队击败了孔戈王国并斩首了孔戈国王安东尼奥一世,又被称作"恩维塔"(Nvita a Nkanga).
de: Portuguese forces defeat the Kingdom of Kongo and decapitate King António I of Kongo, also known as Nvita a Nkanga.

t: "伦敦公报"是现存最古老的刊物,最早出版.
te: The London Gazette, the oldest surviving journal, is first published.
dz: "伦敦公报"是现存最古老的刊物,最早出版.
de: The London Gazette, the oldest surviving journal, is first published.

t: 荷兰皇家海军陆战队由米希尔·德·鲁伊特(英语:Michiel de Ruyter)创立.
te: The Royal Netherlands Marine Corps is founded by Michiel de Ruyter.
dz: 荷兰皇家海军陆战队由米希尔·德·鲁伊特(英语:Michiel de Ruyter)创立.
de: The Royal Netherlands Marine Corps is founded by Michiel de Ruyter.

t: 第一次输血的叙述以医生Richard Lower到化学家Robert Boyle的一封信的形式…
te: The first account of a blood transfusion is published, in the form of a letter from physician Richard Lower to chemist …
dz: 第一次输血的叙述以医生Richard Lower到化学家Robert Boyle的一封信的形式发表 在皇家学会的哲学交易中
de: The first account of a blood transfusion is published, in the form of a letter from physician Richard Lower to chemist Robert Boyle, in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society
